solution.p: Here are two different explanations of how two negative numbers can be added together.
Use a number line. Lets find -10+4.
First, find -10 on the number line. Next, since we are adding a positive number, we move right, in the positive direction, by 4 units. We will reach {-6} on the number line, which is the answer.
A second method asks you to think in terms of money. Lets find -10+4.
The first number is -10. Since its negative, its like you lost 10 dollars while gambling at the casino this morning.
The second number is 4. Since its positive, its like you won 4 dollars while gambling at the casino this afternoon.
Since you lost more money than you won, overall you have lost, implying the answer is negative.
Since you lost 10 dollars and then won 4 dollars, it makes sense that you lost the difference of 10 and 4 dollars, which is {6} dollars. So the final answer is: -10+4={-6}.
